observations: The worker class methods with those names are therefore not overrides and have no repository effect
Spring Batch 6.0.4 JdbcDefaultBatchConfiguration is the JDBC owner and exposes getDataSource/getTransactionManager/getDatabaseType/getTablePrefix
rootCause: The worker retained a pre-Spring-Batch-6 subclass contract. It compiles, but silently creates a resourceless JobRepository instead of the required durable JDBC repository.
requiredRepair: Use the Spring Batch 6 JDBC configuration owner, bind batDataSource/batTransactionManager, return BAT_SB_ as the current table prefix, and prove the actual repository is JDBC-backed.
passProhibited: Compile-only or interface-only evidence cannot close this runtime persistence defect.
